title: 3 ex-officials appeal to top court over 2019 deportation of N. Koreans
caption:
Three former South Korean officials have appealed their convictions related to the 2019 repatriation of two North Korean fishermen. The case hinges on whether the forced return violated the rights of the individuals.

Source: En - 3 ex-officials appeal to top court over 2019 deportation of N. Koreans
